verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a plan-dependent retention lever for runtime logs: retention varies by plan and by whether Observability Plus is enabled. It also offers first-party Log Drains for longer storage, including audit logs sent to S3, Splunk, Datadog and Panther. That is only a thin, indirect form of retention control, and no user-facing deletion capability is evidenced. missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods per data type, documented data/account/project deletion controls, retention controls beyond logs (e.g. AI Gateway request logs, Blob, agent run traces), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Retention depends on your plan and whether Observability Plus is enabled; see Runtime Logs for current limits. For longer log storage, you can use Log Drains.
